title: [ruled C, batch devx-cleanup] Mint a governance label that carries `Clause-②: no`, so the majority arm of the contract declaration stops living in free text that any body edit erases
body:
**Provenance** — filed by the objectstack triage seat (`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`) as the **`domain:skills` half** of ruling **C** on `objectstack-ai/objectstack#16949`. The maintainer ruled letter **C** on 2026-09-23, in the devx-cleanup batch. ⛔ The measurement history is on #16949 and is not duplicated here.

⚠️ **This card is HALF of a pair.** The other half — teaching `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` to read this label as a `no` carrier — stays on **#16949** (`domain:devx`), which is `pm:blocked` behind **this** card: the parser cannot be written until this label has a name and a mint.

## What was ruled

`AGENTS.md:1066-1068` requires every PR to declare `Clause-②: yes|no`. Read the parser, `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs:1226-1228`:

```js
:1226  if (carrier || (line?.kind === 'declared' && line.value === 'yes')) return { value: 'yes', … };
:1227  if (line?.kind === 'declared' && line.value === 'no')                return { value: 'no',  … };
:1228  return { value: null, … };
```

⇒ **`yes` has two carriers** — a durable label, or the body line. **`no` has exactly one**: the body line. There is no label that expresses `no` at all.

⭐ So the loss measured on #16949 was not bad luck — **`no` is the only arm that CAN be lost**, and it is the majority arm: 85 of the last 120 merged PRs declare `no`, and 63 of those 85 carry no changeset file at all (which is why the cheaper "put it in the changeset" route was refused — three quarters of them have no file to write it in).

**Letter C** is: give `no` a governance label of its own, at parity with `needs:contract-review` on the `yes` side.

## What this card delivers

1. A label name, in the PM label vocabulary, with its description — the `no` counterpart of `needs:contract-review`.
2. Its mint, through whatever this repo's label vocabulary actually uses.
3. ⛔ **Not** the parser change. That is #16949.

## ⚠️ Two premises this seat did NOT measure — settle them before writing anything

Both are copied verbatim from #16949's 置信缺口, because they are this half's, not the parser half's:

- ⛔ **untested**: whether the label can be minted by `ensure-pm-labels.sh` **without touching a governed surface**. If minting it requires editing a governed file, that changes how this lands (draft PR + human merge), ⛔ not whether it lands.
- ⛔ **untested**: whether the label vocabulary has a cap or a ratchet that this new entry would break (`check:pm-label-desc-cap` exists and is named in #15082's roster list).

## Why it is here and not in `domain:devx`

Triage's own prior ruling on #16949 (`5599637112`) wrote this split in advance, verbatim: 「⛔ 但若答案是『给 `no` 也发一个标签』,那是**治理标签词表的变更** …… 那一半属 **skills** …… 若认领方选了新增标签这条路,**回报本席同笔改判 skills**,⛔ 不要自行跨过去。」 ⇒ letter C was chosen; this is that re-lane, executed by triage rather than by a claimant crossing lanes.

## Filing gate

Class ① — a reproducible defect with a named landing surface, with a maintainer ruling already attached. Dedupe: #16949 and its thread are the only prior record; the label vocabulary itself carries no `Clause-②` entry today (that absence is the finding).
